name: Silence Dream
roleZh: 设计 & 美术 & 程序 & 音乐音效
desc: This is an experimental game built on the concept of 'transferred design': By uncovering the secrets hidden within the story, you can learn the logic of dream interpretation, discover the characters’ inner monologues, and achieve a renewed understanding of the theme of “the self and one’s inner identity.
descZh: 这是一款实验性游戏，理念基于“转移设计手段”：玩家通过解开藏于剧情中的秘密，了解解梦逻辑，找到角色内心独白，完成对“人与自我”这一主题的重新认知。
detail: An experimental puzzle game designed around the theme of humanity and the self. Drawing on the profound similarities between dream interpretation and the exploration of one’s inner world, the game builds its core logic upon the relationship between dreams and reality. Rather than repeatedly lecturing players to “reflect on themselves,” it gently guides them to understand the methods of dream interpretation, encouraging them to decode their own dreams in real life and seek their true inner selves — thus embodying the theme through personal discovery.
detailZh: 一款主题为人与自我所设计的实验性解谜游戏。由于解梦逻辑与探索自我这一主题的高度相似特征，尝试将梦境与现实的关系构成游戏底层逻辑。游戏通过指导玩家了解解梦的手段，激发玩家在现实中解开自身梦境，寻找自己的内心来阐释主题，而非反复教育玩家要自我反思与批判。

name: LifeCycle
roleZh: 设计 & 美术 & 程序 & 音乐音效
desc: This is an experimental game built on the concept of 'transferred design': Players are trapped in an endless cycle of reincarnation, progressing with the 'assistance' of their previous incarnations. The mechanics faithfully replicate the concepts of rebirth and inherited legacy. However, because the game has no definitive ending—no final level—it seeks to inspire players to ponder the meaning of life beyond eternity and the essence of the world.
descZh: 这是一款实验性游戏，理念基于“转移设计手段”：玩家在游戏中不断轮回，在“上一世”的“帮助”下继续前进。机制还原了轮回，传承的内容，但由于游戏本身没有结束（没有final level），尝试激发玩家思考无尽之后的意义和世界
detail: At its heart, the game speaks of infinity — a vast and majestic theme. Yet rather than letting it dissolve into empty slogans or hollow platitudes, the mechanics turn instead toward something far more intimate and tangible: the quiet inheritance of knowledge and the eternal cycle of reincarnation. For instance, three ancient statues stand as silent witnesses — one for Science, one for Philosophy, and one for Art — each a vessel carrying the echoes of human thought across countless lives. With neither text nor rewards to guide the way, the game unfolds in subtle silence. Through quiet imagery and unspoken resonance, it gently unveils what truly lingers behind the veil of endlessness: the profound meaning, the hidden position, and the quiet question that infinity leaves behind.
detailZh: 游戏主题为无尽，但作为宏大的主题，为了避免游戏表达的内容成为空洞的口号或正确的废话，将机制聚焦于有高度相似特征的主题：传承与轮回。例如游戏中的三个雕像分别代表科学，哲学和艺术。而游戏中没有任何文字或者奖励，隐晦的展现无尽背后所代表的位置。
